contamination_status.summary: the revision-2 survey started and halted mid-sweep; the ledger is retained at exactly 0 bytes and records no contamination event

operator_statement: I accept the Cycle-006 revision-2 pre-freeze halt as the terminal disposition of this survey attempt, at disposition B, terminal type pre-freeze-halt, in the pre-freeze-standalone authority form. The revision-2 survey started and did not complete; the contamination ledger is the reached evidence of that fact and is preserved unchanged at exactly 0 bytes. No survey record and no successor pool were produced, and neither may be represented by a null, placeholder, or stub value. I authorized a narrow evidence-schema correction so this started-but-incomplete state could be recorded truthfully; it changes no survey criterion, no Gate-P authority, no product-family rule, no portal universe, and no scientific result. I do not authorize survey continuation, criterion evaluation, revision 3, pool or freeze construction, Gate F, commit, push, landing, or Sprint closure.
reason: The revision-2 survey lawfully started. Portal 1 reached product-family discovery only; no admission criterion was evaluated against any provider-product. Portal 2's fixed enumeration index provides multiple non-equivalent provider-authored naming signals, and the frozen product-family rule designates none of them as controlling. More than one family set therefore remains consistent with the frozen rule, so the fixed index cannot produce one unique family set. That is the non_unique_route condition, and step 12 requires a pre-freeze-halt on it. No interpretation was chosen and the sweep stopped before portal 3.
